Monsters.Name: Stone Golem

SpecialAttacks.Name: Berserk

SpecialDefenses.Name: Magic Weapon Immunity
SpecialDefenses.Description: Normal weapons do not harm flesh golems; magical weapons have normal effect.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Spell Immunity
SpecialDefenses.Description: Most spells have no effect; fire or cold spells slow the golem by 50% for 2–12 rounds; electrical attacks heal damage equal to the number of dice rolled.

Monsters.Other: 7.5' tall; created by high-level magic-users; extremely strong; can smash through doors and wooden structures.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Pyro hydra breath

SpecialDefenses.Name: Multiple Heads
SpecialDefenses.Description: All heads must be killed to slay the hydra.

Monsters.Other: Damage per attack depends on head count; 8‑headed hydra deals 1–8 damage per bite.

Monsters.Name: Brown Mold

SpecialAttacks.Name: Freezing Aura

SpecialAttacks.Name: Heat-Fed Growth
SpecialAttacks.Description: Exposure to heat causes rapid expansion. Torches, flaming oil, and fire-based spells can increase its area by 2, 4, or 8 times.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Affected Only by Magical Cold
SpecialDefenses.Description: Only magical cold has a significant effect on brown mold.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Dormancy
SpecialDefenses.Description: Cold causes the mold to become dormant for 5-30 turns.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Cold Creature Immunity
SpecialDefenses.Description: Its draining effect does not harm creatures that naturally use or embody cold.

Monsters.Other: Brown mold feeds on radiant energy and body heat rather than light. It is not affected by light spells or faerie fire. White dragon breath or a wand of cold will kill it. Psionic Ability: Nil. Attack/Defense Modes: Nil.
